limitations.title: Heavy JS runtime
limitations.detail: Framer’s React runtime loads on every page, which pushes up TBT and LCP.

limitations.title: Auto-generated markup
limitations.detail: framer-xxxx class names and deeply nested wrappers limit control over the markup.

limitations.title: Hosting lock-in
limitations.detail: CMS content and hosting are hard to move off Framer.

manualRebuild.title: Framer form submissions
manualRebuild.detail: The Framer forms submission endpoint cannot be recreated; connect a form backend.
